description: Attach bytes from a blob (blob_key) to a Jira issue. Content comes from blob storage ONLY — no local path parameter. Optional filename override. Write action. Optional site selects a bound Atlassian site; omitted uses the default. Queued and completed results identify the site. Returns immediately with data {job_id, status: queued}. Retrieve service_interface::job_service::get_job by that exact id until terminal; the complete former response envelope is in job.result and failures are also in job.error. Proceed with dependent work only after successful completion.
embedding_description: Attach blob-storage bytes to a Jira issue, with an optional filename override and site selector. Local paths are not accepted; ingest the file first. Returns data {job_id, status: queued}. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result retains the original response and job.error preserves failures.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued receipt {job_id, status}; after terminal success, job.result.data contains: The new attachment's id and filename.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Retrieve the job by its canonical id and distinguish queued/processing from terminal. After terminal success: Confirm the file was attached to the named issue and give the filename. This adds a real file to a ticket.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Read job_service.get_job until terminal; use job.result for the original result, and handle job.error on failure before dependent work.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Attach bytes from blob storage to a Jira issue.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: jira.invalid_params: key or blob_key was missing, or the blob could not be resolved to bytes. jira.not_found: the issue key does not exist. jira.permission_denied: the account cannot add attachments to this issue. blob_storage_service_not_available: the platform blob store is not bound.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: jira.invalid_params: supply both the issue key and a valid blob_key (ingest a local file via store_blob_from_file first). jira.permission_denied: grant the service account attach permission. jira.not_found: verify the issue key.
